Huwandu hweimpulse yakagamuchirwa nechinhu mukati menguva $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ iyi nokumhanya kwechinhu pakarepo apo simba rapera zvichitevedzana ndeapi? (Hapana mamwe masimba.)
